svg.title: Example 2.1 breadboard wiring: Arduino Uno pin 13 to a 220 ohm resistor, the resistor to the long leg of a red LED, and the LED short leg to the breadboard negative rail, which is connected to the Arduino GND pin
svg.text: Current path: pin 13 → wire → strip 10 → resistor → strip 14 → LED (long leg in, short leg out) → strip 15 → wire → − rail → GND.
Holes in the same numbered column (a–e, or f–j) are one strip, joined inside the breadboard; each rail is joined along its length.
Pin 13 also lights the Arduino's own "L" LED, so you can check the sketch works before you build the circuit.
